The background is dark blue, and the text is white, making it stand out clearly. Vivek's post reads: "I've defended Trump at every step & respect him immensely. You won't hear me attacking him. I'm asking for your vote tonight because I believe it's the right thing for our country. We cannot walk into the other side's trap & watch the puppet masters quietly trot Nikki into power."
